With Amazon's updated early fall Prime Day deals still going strong and AirPods Pro 3 dropping $50, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance discount is back at a near-$200 markdown off the original price. Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also features $150 off the Apple 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB, the return of launch discounts on Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini, and nearly 20% off Apple Magic Keyboard. Pair those deals with Beats woven USB-C cables for under $8, plus a fresh batch of exclusive discounts on iPhone 18 Pro cases. Read on for all the details.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (originally $249)

Back in stock: Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop hits all-time low clearance pricing at nearly $200 off

With the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 now officially here, we have been tracking launch-period deals on multiple configurations over at Amazon. Those will be listed down below, and Amazon's clearance deals on the two most popular Apple Watch Ultra configurations are back in stock at nearly $200 off.

Amazon now offers the Apple Watch Ultra 3 in both Black Titanium and Natural Titanium with matching Milanese Loop bands starting from $699.97 shipped.

$199 below the original $899 price tag and $199 below the going rate on the equivalent Ultra 4 model.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)

We spotted both of these deals yesterday, but stock has been coming in and out pretty quickly since, and things look like they're back in stock right now. These all-time low clearance prices on the Apple Watch just after the new model launched generally deliver the best value on Apple wearables for folks who don't need the latest, and the Ultra 3 is still a perfectly great option that looks just about identical to the newer model.

Here are the configurations of Series 12 and Ultra 4 that currently enjoy launch pricing:

Apple Watch Series 12

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 42mm: $390 (originally $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $440 (originally $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $540 (originally $549)

Apple Watch Ultra 4

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4 GPS + Cellular 49mm: $780 (originally $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4, 49mm, GPS + Cellular: $780 (originally $799)

Apple's 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB discounted $150 at Amazon, official refurbs up to $300 off

While we are still tracking up to $300 off the 15-inch model through Apple's official refurbished store, Amazon is now offering multiple configurations of the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB for $150 below the original price.

The Apple official refurbished store has been a great place to score deals on M5 MacBook Air over the last three months or so. But inventory is very limited right now with only the 15-inch model seeing a discount.

However, Amazon is now offering a solid $150 price drop across all-new 14-inch configurations. That includes the mid-tier 1TB model, as well as the upgraded configuration with 24GB RAM:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (originally $1,799)

As for Apple refurbished deals, the available colors have become more limited since we last shared them, but you can still grab select configurations with up to $300 off right now:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,269 (originally a brand-new $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally a brand-new $1,999)
  • Starlight, Sky Blue

Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini launch discounts are back in town

In addition to the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deals and the early Apple Watch Series 12 launch discounts, Amazon is once again relaunching the launch discounts on Apple's brand new 24GB M6 Mac mini.

Amazon once again has the all-new M6 Mac mini with 24GB RAM and 512GB of storage at $1,269.99 shipped.

While this isn't a huge discount over the $1,299 MSRP, this all-new machine is back down at the lowest price we have tracked, which is a solid savings opportunity for early adopters. The launch-period discounts on the new M6 Mac mini since its release have been a bit rocky, with prices yo-yoing between MSRP and the discounted rate, but as of writing we have both configurations back at the discounted rate again.

This 24GB model deal comes alongside a discount on the mid-tier 16GB model — we will continue to watch for deals on the entry-level model and the M5 Pro:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (originally $1,299)

Most affordable USB-C Apple Magic Keyboard at nearly 20% off for today only

Add Hyper's latest Thunderbolt 5 Dock to your new Mac setup for $80 off (Amazon low)

One of Hyper's latest MacBook and Mac mini/Studio accessories is back down at the lowest price we have tracked over at Amazon — the HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure is now $80 off.

The brand's official Amazon store is once again selling its latest HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure at $319.99 shipped.

Down from $400, this deal matches what we mentioned previously and ties the best Amazon price we have tracked since its release this year, $80 below MSRP.

All-new Beats 360 ANC headphones launch deals: modular Cushion Kit for just $10, 80% off MSRP

As we mentioned yesterday in our roundup of the larger Beats deals, Apple-owned brand has officially launched the all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones with modular ear cushions and headband pads. They're now officially available and we're also getting Beats 360 launch deals today, including the limited-time discount on the Beats 360 Cushion Kit — down to $9.99.

The all-new Beats 360 headphones feature a modular design that lets users swap and switch out both the ear cushions and the headband pads. The headphones themselves of course ship with one matching set of pads, but there are now seven different colorways of the Beats 360 Cushion Kit available so you can freely mix and match your style, or swap in a fresh new set after working out.

  • Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (originally $50)

Early fall Prime Day Ring deals start from $40: latest 4K models at new lows with $100 off, more

Amazon's early fall Prime Day deals cover both the Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro and Battery wireless models, both now down to a new Amazon low at 40% off. Read on for a detailed breakdown of these two models as well as other Prime Big Deal Days offers starting from $40 with shipping.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (originally $250)

You're looking at Ring's two newest 4K video smart doorbells, both at original prices of $250. Now $100 off at a 40% discount to a new Amazon low — these models never dropped below $180 before this early fall Prime deal.

Although Amazon kicked off this year's early fall Prime Day deals earlier than the October 6 start date, it has clearly continued adding new items to these early-bird deals, some of which are very compelling.

These two models are largely identical in features, differing only in whether you choose a hardwired installation or a fully wireless battery-powered setup — the wireless model comes with a Quick Release Ultra battery pack for easy charging and a relatively painless (no wiring) setup process, while the wired model offers "uninterrupted, uninterrupted protection." Beyond that, both feature 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and wide-angle Retinal 4K video capture.
